chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-Amraki ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the saddle and the reins that have silver on them — can one ride with them? He said: If it is coated (with silver) such that one is not able to remove it, then there is no objection; otherwise, do not ride with it.

key_terms.السرج: The saddle — the seat used for riding horses or other animals
key_terms.الفضة: Silver — precious metal whose use as adornment is a matter of jurisprudential debate
key_terms.اللجام: The bridle/reins — the headgear used to control a riding animal
key_terms.لا بأس: No objection/harm — standard jurisprudential expression indicating permissibility
key_terms.ممواه: Coated/plated — silver applied as a thin, inseparable coating that cannot be removed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to use a saddle or bridle adorned with silver in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him) was asked by his brother Ali ibn Ja'far about the permissibility of using riding equipment (saddle and bridle) adorned with silver. The Imam ruled that if the silver is applied as a permanent coating or plating that cannot be removed (tamwih), it is permissible to use; but if the silver is detachable or removable, its use is prohibited. This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle that silver adornment on riding animals is generally forbidden, with an exception for permanently fused silver plating.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the saddle and the reins where is the silver, can one ride with it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it is coated on and you are not able to remove it, so there is no problem, otherwise do not ride with it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-‘Amrakiy ibn Ali from Ali ibn Ja‘far from his brother abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the saddle and the rein in which silver is used; if it can be used. He (the Imam) said, ‘If it is in a whitewashing (painted) form which cannot be removed, then it is not harmful, otherwise, you must not ride with it.’”
